label: NeoRecall
description: Connect a self-hosted NeoRecall server so agents can search personal memories and transcript evidence on demand.

apps.label: Recall
apps.description: Search personal memories and their transcript evidence in a connected NeoRecall account.

connectPrompt: Add the NeoRecall backend URL once, then authorize read-only recall access with OAuth.

tools.name: neorecall_search
tools.description: Search personal NeoRecall memories, mini-memories, daily summaries, and transcript evidence with local hybrid retrieval. Use for open-ended recall of past events, discussions, people, facts, tasks, or promises. Does not invoke NeoRecall Ask or another LLM. When multiple Recall accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Recall account email or identifier.

tools.name: neorecall_list_memories
tools.description: List typed episodic NeoRecall memories, optionally filtered by date window (from/to), type, or topic. Use when reconstructing what happened across a day or period. When multiple Recall accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Recall account email or identifier.

tools.name: neorecall_get_memory
tools.description: Get one NeoRecall memory with mini-memories, entities, topics, and exact transcript evidence links. When multiple Recall accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Recall account email or identifier.

tools.name: neorecall_list_mini_memories
tools.description: List atomic NeoRecall facts, events, people, relationships, tasks, and promises. When multiple Recall accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Recall account email or identifier.

tools.name: neorecall_list_daily_summaries
tools.description: List NeoRecall daily summaries for a date range. Prefer this first for questions about what happened today, yesterday, or on a specific calendar day. When multiple Recall accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Recall account email or identifier.

tools.name: neorecall_list_conversations
tools.description: List NeoRecall transcript conversations for a time range, including titles/summaries and memory-processing state. Use for who the user talked with today or recently. When multiple Recall accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Recall account email or identifier.

tools.name: neorecall_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one NeoRecall conversation with ordered original-language transcript segments and speaker assignments. When multiple Recall accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Recall account email or identifier.
